summary.retainedGeometryCap: No durable geometry added; full response and geometry caches are under ignored tmp only; prior maximum of three durable FI polygon samples preserved.

forcedOneFeaturePaging.scope: One bounded Helsinki native EPSG:3067 rectangle; separate from the 13-cell WUP grid

locatorBindingAssessment: The official WUP point is outside all parcels returned by the 13-cell grid. The nearest full returned parcel footprint is 148.534 m away. Its complete footprint does bind to its canonical INSPIRE URI/native ResourceID through an identical fresh exact-ID geometry hash; the sample does not establish citywide absence or coverage.

geometryQuality.method: Independent Shapely 2.2.0 validity/overlap check after inverse-projecting cached WGS84 features with proj4

oneMetreInteriorSiteProbe.assessment: The WFS reports a stable empty result for this small BBOX despite the checked 1 m site being inside the complete polygon. Retested at 8 m while remaining fully within the parcel; see verifiedInteriorSiteBinding.

eightMetreInteriorSiteProbe.assessment: The WFS also reports a stable empty result for an 8 m square verified to be fully inside the full parcel polygon. The full parcel bbox does return the feature. The subsequent bounded-scale diagnostic tests 1/2/4/8 m and official capabilities for the spatial semantic distinction.

followupExactIdReadback38.scope: Fresh ResourceID exact readback of two features in the complete 13-cell Helsinki WUP cache plus all 36 features in the retained EPSG:3067 stress-cache response.

spatialPredicateQualification.source: National Land Survey of Finland INSPIRE CP WFS GetCapabilities, DescribeFeatureType, and bounded live requests
spatialPredicateQualification.describeFeatureType: Response is an XSD wrapper including http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/schemas/cp/4.0/CadastralParcels.xsd; it does not reveal the service default geometry.
spatialPredicateQualification.inspireModelGeometryAndReferencePoint: The official INSPIRE CP model defines required geometry and optional referencePoint as separate properties.

documentedFesPostTriad.requestForm: WFS 2.0 HTTP POST GetFeature with FES 2.0 BBOX and ValueReference cp:geometry; native EPSG:3067 coordinates
documentedFesPostTriad.requestXmlTemplate: <wfs:GetFeature xmlns:wfs="http://www.opengis.net/wfs/2.0" xmlns:fes="http://www.opengis.net/fes/2.0" xmlns:cp="http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/schemas/cp/4.0" xmlns:gml="http://www.opengis.net/gml/3.2" service="WFS" version="2.0.0" outputFormat="application/gml+xml; version=3.2" resultType="hits"><wfs:Query typeNames="cp:CadastralParcel" srsName="urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::3067"><fes:Filter><fes:BBOX><fes:ValueReference>cp:geometry</fes:ValueReference><gml:Envelope srsName="urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::3067"><gml:lowerCorner>384891.654284 6677338.654</gml:lowerCorner><gml:upperCorner>384892.654284 6677339.654</gml:upperCorner></gml:Envelope></fes:BBOX></fes:Filter></wfs:Query></wfs:GetFeature>
documentedFesPostTriad.qualificationConclusion: The one FES hits response reported 4 matches, while the same known-contained 1m site returned stable 0 with generic KVP BBOX; gateway-rejected data/post responses and the timed-out service continuation prevent a complete manifest and stable readback. This does not establish which geometry property the generic KVP BBOX uses.

stress36MetricTopologyAudit.caveat: This describes only the 36 parcels in the retained stress bbox. Validity and overlap checks used Shapely 2.2.0 in EPSG:3067; no make-valid, snapping, buffering, or repair was applied.

verifiedInteriorSiteBinding.bindingFailureReason: Both contained-site generic KVP BBOX hit checks were stably 0; the documented FES cp:geometry triad could not be completed because its data and post-hit responses were rejected by the gateway.

integrationAdmissionReason: The generic KVP BBOX returned stable zero for verified contained sites; the documented FES cp:geometry probe produced a hits count of four but its data and post-hit requests were rejected, so a complete binding remains unproven.
